executive_summary.text: Cost year 2023: laundry cost per resident day ($1.23) was 23% of the Connecticut median ($5.43). Ask how laundry is handled: by the home's own staff, by a contracted service, or with costs reported in another department.
Cost year 2023: direct care cost was $178.23 per resident day (41.5% of expenses); Connecticut median $167.62.
Cost year 2023: nursing home operating margin was -17.4% (Connecticut median -3.1%).
Cost year 2023: nursing pool (agency) staff counted in direct care cost $250,443, 2.7% of the $9,182,184 direct care cost.

Cost year 2023: dietary cost $1,645,642, $31.94 per resident day (Connecticut median $29.59). Wages $719,253 (43.7%), allocated fringe $175,297 (10.7%), non-wage costs $751,092 (45.6%). Raw food was $536,977 ($10.42 per resident day; Connecticut median $8.24).
Cost year 2023: housekeeping cost $752,161, $14.6 per resident day (Connecticut median $11.59). Wages $549,127 (73.0%), allocated fringe $133,834 (17.8%), non-wage costs $69,200 (9.2%).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read). recommended_follow_up: Ask the home or DSS how laundry costs are reported on the cost report (in-house staff, purchased services or another department).

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
